acceptanceCriteria: the shard cost and test slice tables are regenerated from a go1.27.2 CI run
the retained go1.27.1 tables are kept or superseded per the decision record
body: Decision 0522 leaves the cishards checker and its retained tables at go1.27.1. tools/ci-shard-costs and tools/ci-test-slices now record runtime.Version() and refuse a toolchain the partition does not admit (8410da997). Until the tables are regenerated from a go1.27.2 CI run and the checker pin is moved, the tables cannot be refreshed.

title: Regenerate CI shard-cost and test-slice tables on go1.27.2 together with the cishards checker pin
